title: Actionist production evidence signal
description: One production observation about one capability. Sprint 2 P15 proposal. Research only; UNEXECUTED; NOT_ADMITTED; zero instances exist.

signal_class.description: Only 'quality' ranks a capability. Misfiling environmental as quality inverts rankings in a tens-of-observations regime.

attribution_class_at_observation.description: Copied from the ReleaseManifest at observation time. A signal may only be acted on at or below this class.

ranks_capability.description: MUST be true only when signal_class == 'quality' AND attribution_class supports the claim.

cause_id.description: Shared by correlated observations (e.g. co-rolled-back host-linked packages). Observations sharing a cause_id collapse to one event.

independent.description: False when this observation shares a cause_id with another. Only independent observations count toward provisional -> proven.

zero_tolerance.description: Rights, tenancy or security breach. Retires immediately; never averaged against positive evidence.

tenant_scope.description: 'aggregated_consented' requires explicit contractual permission. Regulated industries excluded by default.

structural_only.description: Learn from structural facts only. Never client content, schema names or copy.

falsified_belief_ref.description: Assumption-ledger id this outcome falsified. First-class output; absent from the external census.

routed_to.description: contract_defect and binding_defect route to backlogs, never to capability score.

then.description: deploy-class attribution cannot name a capability; it may never drive demotion.
